Danapur Cantonment.verdict: Safest residential zone; high natural levee, excellent gravity drainage.

Bailey Road / Khagaul.verdict: Highly suitable for purchasing land/flats; minimal waterlogging risk.

Patliputra Colony.verdict: Suitable with standard municipal storm drainage; moderate flood history.

Gandhi Maidan.verdict: Intermediate river levee terrace; commercial/residential suitable.

Kankarbagh Colony.verdict: High risk of 1-2m waterlogging; buyers must inspect plinth & pump setups.

Rajendra Nagar.verdict: Severe natural depression sink; chronic flood hazard zone.
